categories.ALL.label: All
categories.ALL.title: Every leaf has a story.
categories.ALL.description: Explore our collection and discover the role of each leaf in a cigar’s composition.
categories.CAPA.label: Wrapper
categories.CAPA.title: The first impression.
categories.CAPA.description: The outer leaf wraps the cigar and contributes its appearance, texture and part of its character.
categories.CAPA.detail: The visible surface of the cigar. Its selection unites presentation and character in a single leaf.
categories.CAPOTE.label: Binder
categories.CAPOTE.title: The structure that holds it together.
categories.CAPOTE.description: Surrounds the filler and holds the whole together beneath the wrapper.
categories.CAPOTE.detail: Surrounds the filler and helps maintain the cigar’s shape. It works with the other leaves to give the whole structure.
categories.TRIPA.label: Filler
categories.TRIPA.title: The heart of the blend.
categories.TRIPA.description: Inside, the leaves combine to build the body, aroma and flavor of the blend.
categories.TRIPA.detail: Forms the cigar’s interior. Its contribution combines with other leaves to build the character of each blend.
chapters.Observa_su_silueta_la_nervadura: Observe its outline, central vein and variations in texture. A closer look at the blend’s raw material.
